archive_policy.rule: When the current phase is completed, move its full progress and validation evidence to the archive before creating a fresh progress.json for the next phase.

validation_log.check: Task 1.1.1 shared Toy Broadcast UI tokens and theme
validation_log.evidence: UI_THEME_OK checks=15 validated design-bible colors, typography, spacing, 24 px safe margin, rounded panel/button/field styles, visible focus treatment, shared theme inheritance, and automatic lobby focus. PHASE1_TESTS_OK checks=29 and PLAYER_INTEGRATION_OK checks=41 passed. PHASE7_POLISH_OK checks=31 passed; its existing dummy-audio shutdown emitted AudioStreamWAV/playback leak diagnostics unrelated to the UI resources. Rendered 1280x720 captures phase1-ui-theme-lobby-v3.png and phase1-ui-theme-results.png were inspected: shared cream/slate styling, amber field focus, readable disabled state, neutral lobby status, four-player results, and no clipping or overlap passed.

validation_log.check: Task 1.1.2 semantic gameplay HUD presentation boundary
validation_log.evidence: GAMEPLAY_HUD_OK checks=16 validated asymmetric vitals, clock and state visibility, hazard lines, all Flood exposure states, and spectator target copy through GameplayHud. UI_THEME_OK checks=15, PHASE1_TESTS_OK checks=29, PLAYER_INTEGRATION_OK checks=41, and PHASE7_POLISH_OK checks=31 passed. PLAYABLE_SCENE_NETWORK_PEERS_OK passed authoritative movement, replicated match health HUD and disasters, elimination/spectating, results, five rematches, and disconnect cleanup. The polish test retained its known successful-exit dummy-audio resource diagnostics.

validation_log.check: Task 1.1.3 responsive health, timer, survivor, and hazard components
validation_log.evidence: GAMEPLAY_HUD_OK checks=19 validated fractional health visualization, bottom safe-edge anchoring, timer-card suppression, and deterministic two-chip hazard capping. UI_THEME_OK checks=18, PHASE1_TESTS_OK checks=29, PLAYER_INTEGRATION_OK checks=41, and PHASE7_POLISH_OK checks=31 passed. PLAYABLE_SCENE_NETWORK_PEERS_OK passed five rematches and all presentation/authority checks; PLAYABLE_SCALE_MATRIX_OK passed 4, 8, and 20 players. Rendered overlap captures hud-components-1280x720.png and hud-components-1920x1080.png were inspected: cream metric cards and slate/amber hazard chips remained readable over mixed scenery with consistent safe margins, exactly two hazards, and no clipping or overlap. Display-backed capture used llvmpipe and dummy audio because WSL audio devices were unavailable; capture and tests exited successfully.

validation_log.check: Task 1.1.4 contextual interaction prompt and Milestone 1.1 completion
validation_log.evidence: GAMEPLAY_HUD_OK checks=21 verified permanent prototype copy is absent and the contextual prompt is bottom-anchored and hidden without an action. GRAB_MANAGER_OK checks=22 validated candidate range, shared nearest selection, and owned-prop rejection. PLAYER_INTEGRATION_OK checks=43 validated GRAB OBJECT to RELEASE OBJECT transitions; PHASE1_TESTS_OK checks=31, UI_THEME_OK checks=18, and PHASE7_POLISH_OK checks=31 passed. PLAYABLE_SCENE_NETWORK_PEERS_OK passed authority, presentation, five rematches, and disconnect cleanup. Inspected context-prompt-visible-1280x720.png and context-prompt-hidden-1280x720.png confirmed the title/control legend is absent, the release prompt is readable and non-overlapping, and no prompt remains without an interaction. Display capture retained the known WSL dummy-audio fallback.

godot --headless --path . --script res://tests/test_gameplay_hud.gd: GAMEPLAY_HUD_OK checks=49 covers all six icons/names/actions, fractional and exact countdown boundaries, minimum one second, nearest-deadline priority, stable ties, handoff, no stale warning, lobby/results suppression, and non-overlapping tray placement. UI_THEME_OK checks=18, PHASE1_TESTS_OK checks=31, PLAYER_INTEGRATION_OK checks=43 passed. GODOT_BIN=$(command -v godot) tests/run_playable_scene_network_test.sh: PLAYABLE_SCENE_NETWORK_PEERS_OK including five rematches and disconnect cleanup. Display-backed runs of test_gameplay_hud.gd with --audio-driver Dummy --resolution 1280x720 and 1920x1080 -- --capture-dir=.amp/in/artifacts passed checks=56 each. All six 720p icon states and revised overlap at both resolutions were inspected; the initial 720p player-head occlusion was fixed by tightening banner/tray spacing and chip height. WSL llvmpipe and Dummy audio were used; some runs emitted intermittent successful-exit resource diagnostics. Remaining milestone gates require later chip, personal-danger, and motion tasks.

validation_log.check: User-requested full Milestone 1.1 re-verification after Task 1.2.1
validation_log.evidence: All four milestone gates remain passed. Inspected ui_tokens.gd, GameplayHud, main.gd presenter calls, scene anchors, and GrabManager read-only candidate/authoritative request boundaries. Re-ran godot --headless --path . --script res://tests/{suite}.gd: UI_THEME_OK checks=18, GAMEPLAY_HUD_OK checks=49, GRAB_MANAGER_OK checks=22, PLAYER_INTEGRATION_OK checks=43, PHASE1_TESTS_OK checks=31, PHASE7_POLISH_OK checks=31, REMATCH_INTEGRATION_OK cycles=5 checks=165. Added reusable tests/test_milestone_1_1.gd: headless checks=79, display-backed checks=84 each at 1280x720 and 1920x1080 with --audio-driver Dummy -- --capture-dir=.amp/in/artifacts. Checks cover one theme resource across every top-level control, immutable authoritative match/health/disaster snapshot during presentation, bar boundaries, stale second-chip removal, defensive hazard getter copy, GRAB/RELEASE and ineligible/eliminated/lobby/results/spectator prompt suppression, safe-area and pairwise non-overlap geometry, unclipped copy, field/button focus, actual lobby-toggle signals, and disabled style fixture. Inspected milestone-1-1 light/dark/empty/lobby-focus/button-focus captures: readable 20/20 counts, timer, health bar, two chips, contextual prompt, amber focus rings and distinct disabled style; no HUD clipping/overlap at either resolution. Earlier dark/light evidence used mixed scenery; this pass explicitly lowered sunlight and ambient illumination and changed the background for the dark fixture. Persistent MULTIPLAYER LOBBY [L] is an actionable toggle verified by signal, not removed prototype/debug copy. GODOT_BIN=$(command -v godot) tests/run_playable_scene_network_test.sh passed five rematches/disconnect cleanup; tests/run_playable_scale_test.sh passed 4/8/20-player HUD, movement, disaster, and ownership checks. Existing HUD/polish/rematch suites still emit successful-exit resource diagnostics; new milestone suite exited cleanly. Rendering uses WSL llvmpipe, not native Windows performance evidence. No production code changes or new milestone work were needed.

validation_log.check: Task 1.2.2 compact active-hazard and combination chips
validation_log.evidence: godot --headless --path . --script res://tests/test_gameplay_hud.gd: GAMEPLAY_HUD_OK checks=71 covers six chip icons/names, two-chip cap, compact incoming identity, interaction priority and constituent deduplication, electrification after flash expiry, expiry to one icon, warning-only Fire versus active wind interaction, and presentation snapshot immutability. Display-backed runs with --audio-driver Dummy --resolution 1280x720 and 1920x1080 -- --capture-dir=.amp/in/artifacts: checks=93 each including content containment and captures. Inspected all six 720p warning/chip icons, electric combination at both resolutions, wind combination with banner at 720p and without banner at 1080p, and dark-world 720p chips: legible paired icons/copy, no clipping or player occlusion. DISASTER_COMBINATIONS_OK checks=20, UI_THEME_OK checks=18, PHASE1_TESTS_OK checks=31, PLAYER_INTEGRATION_OK checks=43 passed. Initial Milestone 1.1 layout regression emitted missing-node errors because chip labels moved into Content; fixed paths and compact fixtures, then MILESTONE_1_1_OK checks=79 headless and checks=84 display-backed at 720p passed cleanly. GODOT_BIN=$(command -v godot) tests/run_playable_scene_network_test.sh: PLAYABLE_SCENE_NETWORK_PEERS_OK including combination replication, five rematches and disconnect cleanup. Existing HUD/combination resource diagnostics persist on successful exit. Rendering uses WSL llvmpipe/Dummy audio; not native Windows performance evidence. Remaining milestone gates await personal-danger and motion work.

validation_log.check: Task 1.2.3 unified personal Flood danger channel
validation_log.evidence: godot --headless --path . --script res://tests/test_gameplay_hud.gd: GAMEPLAY_HUD_OK checks=79 validates one wading/grace/drowning card, exact copy, authoritative snapshot immutability, no tint/health flashing, warning instruction and context-prompt priority in both call orders, and restoration/clearing on safety. PLAYER_INTEGRATION_OK checks=50 validates actual Flood exposure, exact two-second grace boundary then damage, lobby/results/open-lobby/spectator suppression, resumed exposure and dry-ground clearing. FLOOD_OK checks=29, MILESTONE_1_1_OK checks=78, UI_THEME_OK checks=18 passed. Display-backed test_gameplay_hud.gd with --audio-driver Dummy --resolution 1280x720 and 1920x1080 -- --capture-dir=.amp/in/artifacts: checks=140 each including safe-area, content containment, and no card overlaps. Inspected personal-wading, personal-breathing, personal-drowning and personal-safe at 720p plus personal-drowning-dark at 1080p: legible one-card instructions, unobscured player, preserved incoming identity/countdown, restored safe-state action/prompt. GODOT_BIN=$(command -v godot) tests/run_playable_scene_network_test.sh: PLAYABLE_SCENE_NETWORK_PEERS_OK including five rematches and disconnect cleanup. Existing intermittent successful-exit HUD resource diagnostics remain. Captures use deterministic presentation fixtures with WSL llvmpipe/Dummy audio; actual exposure/damage is exercised separately by integration/Flood tests. Final motion/overlap gate remains Task 1.2.4.

validation_log.check: Task 1.2.4 warning motion/audio feedback and Milestone 1.2 completion
validation_log.evidence: godot --headless --path . --script res://tests/test_gameplay_hud.gd: GAMEPLAY_HUD_OK checks=95 covers bounded entrance/settle, no per-frame restart, final-three-second cue/emphasis, duplicate/upward snapshot correction suppression, single cue for skipped seconds, no handoff cue, immediate reduced-motion cancellation, preserved audio feedback, reserved warning stream/pool cap, hiding/reset and repeat entrance. Initial exact 0.85 Color-alpha assertions failed on float representation; corrected them to is_equal_approx, then reran successfully. PHASE7_POLISH_OK checks=34 validates quiet countdown effect routing, normal volume restoration on voice reuse, and reserved stream; PLAYER_INTEGRATION_OK checks=50, MILESTONE_1_1_OK checks=78, UI_THEME_OK checks=18 passed. Display-backed test_gameplay_hud.gd --audio-driver Dummy --resolution 1280x720 and 1920x1080 -- --capture-dir=.amp/in/artifacts: checks=177 each. Inspected motion-entrance at 720p, motion-overlap at both resolutions, and motion-reduced-overlap in dark 720p scenery: readable entering banner, final count, two chips, one drowning instruction card, no clipped copy/card overlaps or obscured player; fixture includes visible Flood water and a Tornado warning. GODOT_BIN=$(command -v godot) tests/run_playable_scene_network_test.sh passed five rematches and disconnect cleanup; tests/run_playable_scale_test.sh passed local 4/8/20-peer matrix. All four Milestone 1.2 gates passed. Existing intermittent successful-exit HUD resource diagnostics remain. WSL llvmpipe and dummy audio do not establish physical audio audibility, Windows performance, or multi-PC playtesting. Reduced-motion persistence/control remains Milestone 1.5.
